sections.name: File setup

sections.what: Brings in the response helper, the session reader, the sign-in settings and the environment reader.
sections.why: These are needed to read the request and the signed-in user.

sections.name: isAdminRequest
sections.title: Who counts as an admin
sections.what: Returns yes if the request carries the scheduled-job secret, or if the signed-in user's email is in the admin list. Otherwise returns no.
sections.why: Keeps destructive and scoring routes limited to the owner and automated jobs.
sections.watch_out: The email must match the admin list in lower case, and an empty list means email admins are never accepted.

sections.name: adminOnly
sections.title: Refusal response
sections.what: Builds a 403 reply with the message that admin access is required.
sections.why: Gives every protected route the same refusal.
sections.watch_out: The calling route must return this reply itself, since this helper does not stop the route on its own.

summary: The gatekeeper for sensitive routes: it lets in scheduled jobs that present the secret, and signed-in admins listed by email.
purpose: It protects routes that delete data or change scores, so that only the owner or scheduled jobs can use them.
why: Likely reason: these routes must not be open to every visitor.
how: It first checks whether the request carries the scheduled-job secret as a bearer token. If not, and the admin list is not empty, it reads the signed-in user's email and checks it against the list. If neither matches, access is refused. A separate helper builds the refusal response.
inputs: The incoming request, its authorisation header, and the signed-in session.
outputs: A yes or no answer, and a 403 Forbidden JSON reply for refused requests.
risks: If ADMIN_EMAILS holds upper-case letters, no email will match. An empty admin list blocks all email sign-ins.
debug: If an admin is refused, check that the email is in ADMIN_EMAILS in lower case and that the user is signed in. For scheduled jobs, check the bearer token matches the secret exactly.
